title: a preset list that fills sibling fields
summary: a list section whose rows are shortcuts: picking one fills the field sections beside it, one of which reveals a further field conditionally, and each row can show a value computed live rather than written into the page

title: a directory browser menu
summary: a menu that drills through folders and picks a file, fed by a host-supplied async fetchDir so the package stays server-agnostic

title: a two-by-two button grid
summary: four equal-size buttons in a two-by-two grid, with handlers bound by id so they do not depend on the layout

title: stepper rows
summary: a stack of labelled plus/minus controls, one per row, label left and value with buttons right-aligned

title: a split toolbar row
summary: one toolbar row with ordered controls on the left, a flexible spacer, and one or two primary actions alone on the right
